testimonials.t1: Caakus ya canza rayuwata! Na sami abokai daga ƙasashe 30+ kuma na sami sama da $500 a Yuyu kawai ta hanyar zama mai zamantakewa. Dandalin yana da sauƙin amfani kuma ba a san kowa ba gaba ɗaya. Mafi kyawun app na zamantakewa da na taɓa amfani!
testimonials.t2: A matsayina na ɗan tafiya na dijital, Caakus yana taimaka na ci gaba da haɗin kai ko'ina. Tsarin murya na farko yana da hazaƙa — zan iya horar da harsuna, yin hulɗar sana'a, da samun crypto duka a lokaci guda. Na ba da shawarar sosai!
testimonials.t3: A ƙarshe dandalin zamantakewa da ke biyan NI kuɗi maimakon tattara bayanan na! Ladar cryptocurrency gaskiya ne, al'umma tana da kyau, kuma ina son cewa ba a san kowa ba gaba ɗaya. Na gode Bryan don ƙirƙirar wannan!

useCases.languageLearningStory: Ina koyon Japanese kuma Caakus ya kasance mai ban mamaki. Ina yin atisaye da masu magana na asali kowace rana kyauta, kuma na inganta fiye da watanni 3 fiye da shekaru 2 na aikace-aikace. Bugu da ƙari na sami $200 a Yuyu kawai ta hanyar tattaunawa!
useCases.remoteNetworkingStory: A matsayina na mai haɓaka freelance, Caakus yana taimaka na yi hulɗa da abokan ciniki masu yiwuwa a duniya. Na sami ayyuka 3 ta hanyar alaƙar da na yi a nan, kuma dandalin yana biyan ni yayin da nake yin hulɗa. Yana da ban sha'awa!
useCases.culturalExchangeStory: Na sami abokai daga ƙasashe 25 daban-daban. Kowace tattaunawa tana koya mini wani abu sabo game da duniya. Caakus ya faɗaɗa ra'ayi na fiye da kowace tafiya.
useCases.combatLonelinessStory: Bayan ƙaura zuwa sabon birni a lokacin annoba, na ji kamar an ware ni. Caakus ya ba ni damar nan take yin tattaunawa mai daɗi 24/7. Ya taimaka mini a lokaci mai wahala kuma na yi abokantaka na gaske.
useCases.sideIncomeStory: Ina amfani da Caakus yayin tafiyata da hutuna. A cikin watanni 6, na sami sama da $800 a cryptocurrency kawai daga tattaunawa na yau da kullum. Ba kuɗi ne da zai canza rayuwa ba, amma gaskiyar kuɗin da ake samu ba tare da aiki ba ne na lokacin da zan ɓata ko ta yaya.
useCases.socialSkillsStory: A matsayina na wanda ke da damuwa ta zamantakewa, Caakus yana barin na yi atisayen tattaunawa a yanayi mai sauƙi. Zan iya tsallakewa idan ban ji daɗi ba, kuma rashin sanin kowa yana taimaka mini in kasance mai kwarin gwiwa. Ƙwarewar zamantakewa na a rayuwar gaske sun inganta sosai.

about.title: Game da Caakus
about.description: Kiran bidiyo, tattaunawa ta murya, kyaututtuka, wasanni, da tattalin arziƙin masu ƙirƙira — duka a cikin dandalin zamantakewa mara bayyana suna

about.heroDesc: Dandalin zamantakewa na farko a duniya inda tattaunawa ta gaske ke ƙirƙirar ƙimar tattalin arziƙi ta hanyar ladan cryptocurrency.

mission.title: Manufar mu
mission.body: Caakus yana haɗa mutane daga ko'ina cikin duniya ta bidiyo na ainihi, murya, da tattaunawa. Muna gina gadar haɗi tsakanin al'adu, harsuna, da nahiyoyi — muna barin kowa ya bayyana kansa cikin 'yanci yayin samun Tsabar YUYU, aika kyaututtuka, hawan jadawalin masu jagoranci, har ma da samun kuɗi daga kasancewar su ta zamantakewa. Ko kuna son tattaunawa mara suna ko aikin ƙirƙira mai bunƙasa, Caakus an gina shi don ku.
mission.body1: A Caakus, mun gaskata cewa haɗin ɗan adam na gaske ya kamata a ba shi lada. Muna juya hanyoyin sadarwar zamantakewa ta hanyar ƙirƙirar dandalin farko inda kowace tattaunawa, kowace kiran bidiyo, da kowace hulɗar zamantakewa ke ƙirƙirar ƙimar tattalin arziƙi na ainihi ga masu amfani.
mission.body2: Manufar mu ita ce ɗamarar damar samun kuɗin cryptocurrency yayin haɓaka haɗin kai na duniya na gaske. Ko kai ɗalibi ne a Tokyo, ɗan kasuwa a Lagos, ko mai ritaya a Paris — kowa ya cancanci samun kuɗi daga hulɗar zamantakewa ta su.

authenticity.title: Gaskiya Da Farko
authenticity.body: Muna ba da fifiko ga haɗin ɗan adam na gaske akan shiga da aka yi na ƙarya. Babu bots, babu bayanan martaba na karya, babu hulɗar da aka ƙera — mutane na gaske kawai suna yin tattaunawa na gaske.

privacy.title: Sirri Na Da Muhimmanci
privacy.body: Sirrin ku abin tsarki ne. Muna aiki cikin cikakken ɓoye suna — babu imel, babu lambar waya, babu tattara bayanan sirri. Ku haɗu cikin 'yanci ba tare da yin illa ga asalin ku ba.

fairness.title: Tattalin Arziƙi Mai Adalci
fairness.body: Masu amfani suna samun 50% na ƙimar kyaututtuka, 92% na ladan ƙalubale, da 100% na mallakar kuɗin da suka samu. Mun gaskata cikin rabon ƙima mai adalci da tattalin arziƙi mai gaskiya.

vision.title: Hangen Nesan mu don Nan Gaba
vision.body: Muna ganin duniya inda dandalin kafofin watsa labarai na zamantakewa ke biyan masu amfani daidai don kulawar su da shigar su. Caakus yana jagorantar sauyin daga hanyoyin sadarwa na zamantakewa masu lalacewa waɗanda ke samun riba daga bayanan masu amfani, zuwa dandamali masu samarwa waɗanda ke ƙirƙirar ƙima ga kowa. Nan da 2026, muna shirin biyan fiye da $100 miliyan a kuɗin cryptocurrency ga al'ummar mu ta duniya.

anonymous.title: Mara Bayyana Suna & Mai Tsaro
anonymous.body: Ana kare bayanan ku. Kiran bidiyo, tattaunawa ta murya, ko rubutu — duka ba tare da yin illa ga sirrin ku ba.

multilanguage.title: Harsuna da Dama
multilanguage.body: Harsuna fiye da 11 masu samuwa don ku iya tattaunawa ta bidiyo da haɗuwa da duk duniya ba tare da cikas ba.

instant.title: Haɗi nan da nan
instant.body: Haɗu da wani don bidiyo ko kiran murya cikin daƙiƙa 1. Babu jira, babu wahala.

hdVideo.title: Bidiyo HD & Kiran Murya
hdVideo.body: Jin daɗin ingancin bidiyo HD 1080p mai tsabta da sauti na matakin ƙwararru. Fasahar WebRTC ta mu tana tabbatar da sadarwa mara matsala, har ma a haɗin da ke a hankali. Daidaita ƙarfin kwararar bayanai ta atomatik yana daidaita ingancin don mafi kyawun aiki.

matching.title: Haɗawa Mai Sauri
matching.body: Haɗu cikin ƙasa da daƙiƙa 3 da tsarin haɗawa na musamman. Babu ɗakin jira, babu jeri, babu jinkiri. Tsarin haɗawa na mataki uku yana amfani da neman gaba da jagora mai wayo don tabbatar da haɗi nan take a duniya.

crypto.title: Sami Cryptocurrency
crypto.body: Karɓi Yuyu don kowace hulɗa. Karɓi kyaututtuka yayin kira (ajiye 50%), ci nasara a ƙalubalen bidiyo (ajiye 92%), kammala nasarori na yau da kullun kuma gina jerin kwanaki don ƙarin lada. Kuɗin da kuka samu 100% na ku ne — cire a kowane lokaci.

anonymousFull.title: Ba a San Ku Ba 100%
anonymousFull.body: Yi amfani da Caakus nan take ba tare da rajista ko ɗaya ba. Babu imel, babu lambar waya, babu bayanan sirri da ake buƙata. An ɓoye dukkan tattaunawa daga ƙarshe zuwa ƙarshe da amfani da ɓoyayyen AES-256 na matakin soja. Ba a taɓa raba asalin ku ba.

globalReach.title: Ƙasashe 150+
globalReach.body: Haɗu da mutane a kowace nahiya. Dandalin yana samuwa a harsuna 11+ tare da haɗawa ta harshe mai wayo. Yi atisaye da sabbin harsuna tare da masu magana na asali ko tattaunawa a harshen da kuka fi so. Haɗin duniya na gaske.

gifts.title: Kyaututtuka na Kamala
gifts.body: Aika da karɓan kyaututtuka na kamala masu ƙimar cryptocurrency na gaske yayin tattaunawa. Masu karɓa suna ajiye 50% na ƙimar a Yuyu. Canza ji mai kyau zuwa kuɗi na gaske. Fiye da zaɓuɓɓukan kyaututtuka 50 masu keɓanta suna samuwa.

story.p1: Bryan Lewis Dongue Ndiffo, ɗan kasuwar fasaha mai shekaru 22 daga Worms, Jamus, ya kafa Caakus a 2025. An haife shi a ranar 18 ga Nuwamba 2003, Bryan yana da cikakken ilimi a fasahar blockchain, fintech, da injiniyan dandalin zamantakewa.
story.p2: Ra'ayin Caakus ya fito daga lura mai sauƙi: biliyoyin mutane suna kashe awanni a kowace rana a dandalin kafofin watsa labarai, suna ƙirƙirar ƙima mai girma ga manyan kamfanonin fasaha — ba tare da samun komai a madadinsa ba. Bryan ya yi hasashen wani tsari daban inda masu amfani za su zama masu cin gajiyar ƙimar tattalin arziƙi da suka ƙirƙira kai tsaye.
story.p3: Abin da ke sa Caakus ya zama juyin juya hali ba kawai ladan cryptocurrency ba ne — sanin cewa haɗin ɗan adam na gaske yana da ƙima na asali wanda ya kamata a raba shi da waɗanda suka ƙirƙire shi.

timeline1.title: Ƙaddamar da Dandalin
timeline1.desc: An ƙaddamar da Caakus bisa hukuma tare da fasalolin tattaunawa ta bidiyo da murya. Mayar da hankali na farko a Turai da Arewacin Amurka. Masu amfani 10,000 na farko sun yi rajista a cikin mako na farko.

timeline2.title: Ƙaddamar da Yuyu
timeline2.desc: An ƙaddamar da cryptocurrency Yuyu a blockchain Coinbase BASE Layer 2. An fara rabon ladan cryptocurrency ga masu amfani. An gabatar da injinin ƙona ta atomatik na 1%.

timeline3.title: Miliyan 1 Masu Amfani
timeline3.desc: Caakus ya kai miliyan 1 masu amfani masu aiki a ƙasashe 150+. An ƙaddamar da fasalin kyaututtuka na kamala. Fiye da $1 miliyan a kuɗin da aka biya masu amfani.

timeline4.title: Faɗaɗa Duniya
timeline4.desc: Dandalin ya faɗaɗa zuwa ƙasashe 150+ tare da tallafin harsuna 11+. An gabatar da ƙalubalen bidiyo da tsarin nasarori.

timeline5.title: Nan Gaba
timeline5.desc: Tsarin hanyar mu ya haɗa da fassarar AI, haɗin AR/VR, mulki mara tsakiya, da faɗaɗa zuwa ƙasashe 200+. Manufa: $100M+ da aka biya masu amfani.

story.philosophyIntro: Ba kawai muna gina dandalin zamantakewa ba — muna jagorantar sabon tsarin tattalin arziƙi na intanet. Wanda:
story.philosophyPoint1: Masu amfani suna mallakar bayanan su kuma suna sarrafa sirrin su gaba ɗaya
story.philosophyPoint2: Ƙimar tattalin arziƙi tana gudana kai tsaye zuwa waɗanda suka ƙirƙire shi
story.philosophyPoint3: Fasaha tana hidimar ɗan adam, ba akasin haka ba
story.philosophyPoint4: Ana ƙimanta haɗi na gaske sama da shiga na ƙirƙira
story.philosophyPoint5: Samun dama ga kuɗi haƙƙi ne, ba gata ba

faq.title: Tambayoyin da Ake Yawan Yi
faq.q1: Menene ke sa Caakus ya bambanta da sauran dandalin zamantakewa?
faq.a1p1: Caakus shi ne dandalin farko a duniya inda masu amfani ke samun cryptocurrency (Yuyu) don hulɗar zamantakewa na gaske. Ba kamar Instagram, TikTok ko Snapchat ba, inda dandalin ke samun riba daga bayanan ku ba tare da ku sami komai ba, Caakus yana raba ƙimar tattalin arziƙi kai tsaye da masu amfani.
faq.a1p2: Mun kuma ba da fifikon cikakken ɓoye suna — babu imel, babu lambar waya, babu tattara bayanan sirri — yayin da har yanzu muke ba da ladan cryptocurrency ta hanyar haɗin blockchain.
faq.q2: Yaya zan fara samun kuɗi a Caakus?
faq.a2Intro: Fara samun kuɗi nan take ta hanyoyi da dama:
faq.a2GiftsDesc: Karɓi kyaututtuka yayin kira — ajiye 50% na ƙimar a Yuyu
faq.a2ChallengesDesc: Ci nasara a gasa kuma ajiye 92% na lada
faq.a2AchievementsDesc: Kammala ayyuka kamar "Kira na Farko na Rana" ko "Tattaunawa 5"
faq.a2ReferralDesc: Sami $5 don kowane abokin da ya yi rajista da kuma 20% kuɗin ci gaba
faq.a2StreaksLabel: Jerin Kwanaki na Yau da Kullun:
faq.a2StreaksDesc: Kwanaki masu bi-da-bi suna ƙara kuɗi (jerin kwanaki 30 = ninkawa 2x)
faq.q3: Shin Caakus kyauta ne da gaske?
faq.a3: Eh! Caakus cikakke kyauta ne. Kuna iya fara yin kiran bidiyo, kiran murya da samun Yuyu nan take ba tare da biyan komai ba. Muna ba da biyan kuɗi na premium na zaɓi ($9.99/wata) waɗanda ke buɗe fasaloli na musamman — amma dandalin na asali 100% kyauta ne har abada.
faq.q4: Menene Yuyu kuma yaya yake aiki?
faq.a4p1: Yuyu shine cryptocurrency na asali na Caakus da aka gina a blockchain Coinbase BASE Layer 2 (tikitin ERC-20). Yana da tsari na musamman na rage inda 1% na dukkan ma'amaloli ke ƙonewa ta atomatik, yana ƙirƙirar ƙarancin samuwa da ƙimar dogon lokaci.
faq.a4p2: Kuna iya amfani da Yuyu don: aika kyaututtuka na kamala, shiga cikin ƙalubale, buɗe fasalolin premium, ko cire zuwa walat ɗin cryptocurrency kuma ku yi ciniki a kasuwannin musayar.
faq.q5: Zan iya cire kuɗin Yuyu na?
faq.a5: Tabbas! Kuɗin da kuka samu 100% na ku ne. Cire zuwa walat ɗin cryptocurrency a kowane lokaci. Tun da Yuyu yana a Coinbase BASE Layer 2, kuna iya canza shi zuwa ETH, USDC ko canza zuwa kuɗin fiat ta kasuwannin musayar.
faq.q6: Yaya Caakus ke tabbatar da tsaron masu amfani?
faq.a6Intro: Tsaro shine fifikon mu na farko. Mun aiwatar da matakan tsaro da dama:
faq.a6Item1: Ɓoyayyen AES-256 daga ƙarshe zuwa ƙarshe a dukkan sadarwa
faq.a6Item2: Kula da abun ciki ta atomatik da gano na AI
faq.a6Item3: Kayan aikin rahoto nan take da sa ido 24/7
faq.a6Item4: Ikon toshe da rahoto hali marar dacewa nan take
faq.a6Item5: Bin ka'idojin GDPR, CCPA da buƙatun shekaru 18+
faq.a7: Caakus yana tallafawa harsuna 11+: Turanci, Faransanci, Jamusanci, Sifaniyanci, Fotugis, Larabci, Sinanci, Jafananci, Koriyanci, Hindi da Rashanci. Tsarin haɗawa mai wayo na mu zai iya haɗa ku da masu magana na asali don horar da harshe.
faq.a8: Bryan Lewis Dongue Ndiffo, ɗan kasuwar fasaha mai shekaru 22 da ke zaune a Worms, Jamus, ya kafa Caakus. An haife shi a ranar 18 ga Nuwamba 2003, Bryan yana da ƙwararren ilimi a blockchain, fintech da dandalin zamantakewa.

faq.title: Tambayoyin da Ake Yawan Yi
faq.description: Samu amsoshi cikin sauri ga tambayoyi na yau da kullun game da Caakus
faq.a1: Tsarin haɗawa mai wayo yana haɗa ku don kiran bidiyo ko murya dangane da harshen ku da zaɓuɓɓukan ku. Yadda kuke aiki sosai, haka Tsabar YUYU ɗin ku ke ƙaruwa kuma fifikon haɗawa ya fi kyau!
faq.a2: Kuna samun Tsabar YUYU ta hanyar kasancewa mai aiki a Caakus — kiran bidiyo, tattaunawa ta murya, aika da karɓan kyaututtuka, kammala ƙalubale, jerin kwanaki na yau da kullun, da ƙari. Tsabar YUYU mafi girma tana buɗe haɗawa mafi kyau, matsayin jadawalin masu jagoranci, da fasalolin al'umma!
faq.q3: Menene matakan da alamun yake yi?
faq.a3: Caakus yana da cikakken tsarin ci gaba da matakan 100 da alamun mataki (Tagulla, Azurfa, Zinare, Almara). Ku haura mataki ta samun XP ta hanyar kashe tsabar kuɗi da kasancewa mai aiki. Matakai mafi girma suna buɗe fasaloli na musamman da sanin al'umma.
faq.a4: Tabbas! Muna amfani da ɓoyayyen bayanai na matakin kasuwanci don dukkan sadarwar bidiyo da murya. Tattaunawar ku ɓoyayyiya ce daga ƙarshe zuwa ƙarshe kuma ba mu taɓa adana rikodin ba. Kuna sarrafa saituna na sirri kuma kuna iya rahoto duk wata hali marar dacewa.
faq.q5: Yaya kyaututtuka, walat, da biyan kuɗi ke aiki?
faq.a5: Aika kyaututtuka na kamala daga Kasuwar Kyaututtuka ga sauran masu amfani. Kyaututtukan da aka karɓa suna canjawa zuwa ma'aunin walat. Kuna iya cire kuɗin ku a kowane lokaci ta Stripe — canja wurin banki na al'ada ko biyan kuɗi nan take. Tattalin arziƙin masu ƙirƙira ne na ainihi!

privacy.title: Manufar Sirri
privacy.contactDesc: Don kowanne tambayoyi game da wannan manufar, da fatan za a tuntuɓe mu.
privacy.reviewPolicyPre: Da fatan za a kuma duba
privacy.reviewPolicyPost: don fahimtar yadda muke kula da bayanan ku na sirri.

intro.title: 1. Gabatarwa
intro.content: A Caakus, muna ɗaukar sirrin ku da muhimmanci sosai. Wannan manufar sirri tana bayyana yadda muke tattarawa, amfani, raba, da kare bayanan ku na sirri lokacin da kuke amfani da dandalin mu na sadarwa ta bidiyo, murya, da zamantakewa na ainihi.

sub1.title: 2.1 Bayanan da kuke ba mu
items: Sunan mai amfani da bayanan martaba

sub2.title: 2.2 Bayanan da ake tattarawa kai tsaye
items: Bayanan tattaunawa (tsawon lokaci, abokan hulɗa, harsuna)

use.title: 3. Amfani da Bayanai
use.content: Muna amfani da bayanan ku don samarwa, ingantawa, da keɓance sabis ɗin mu, haɗa ku da sauran masu amfani, da tabbatar da tsaron dandalin.

sharing.title: 4. Raba Bayanai
sharing.content: Ba ma sayar da bayanan ku. Muna raba su ne kawai da izinin ku, da masu samar da sabis, ko lokacin da doka ta buƙata.

security.title: 5. Tsaron Bayanai
security.content: Muna aiwatar da matakan tsaro na fasaha da na ƙungiya masu dacewa don kare bayanan ku na sirri daga shiga ba tare da izini ba, gyarawa, bayyanawa, ko lalacewa. Wannan ya haɗa da ɓoyayyar bayanai, tabbatar da sahihanci, da ƙayyadaddun damar shiga.

retention.title: 6. Ajiyar Bayanai
retention.content: Ba a rikodin tattaunawar bidiyo da murya. Muna ajiye bayanan ku na sirri muddin ya zama dole don sabis ɗin mu da wajibcin doka.

rights.title: 7. Haƙƙoƙin ku
rights.content: Bisa ga GDPR da dokokin kare bayanai masu dacewa, kuna da haƙƙin:
items: Samun damar bayanan ku na sirri
Gyara bayanan da ba su daidai ba ko marasa cikawa
Share bayanan ku (haƙƙin a manta da su)
Yin adawa da sarrafa bayanan ku
Karɓar bayanan ku a cikin tsarin da za a iya canja wuri
Janye izinin ku a kowane lokaci

cookies.title: 8. Kukis
cookies.content: Muna amfani da kukis don inganta ƙwarewar ku. Kuna iya sarrafa zaɓuɓɓukan ku a cikin saituna na burauzan ku.
cookies.additionalContent: Bugu da ƙari, masu samar da ɓangare na uku da suka haɗa da Google na iya amfani da kukis don nuna tallace-tallace da tattara bayanan nazari. Kuna iya sarrafa zaɓuɓɓukan kukis a saituna na burauzan ku.

minors.title: 9. Kare Ƙananan Yara
minors.content: Sabis ɗin mu an yi shi ne don masu amfani masu shekaru 13 zuwa sama. Ba ma san da tattara bayanai daga yara ƙasa da shekaru 13 ba.

moderation.title: 10. Kula da Abun ciki & Tsaron Masu Amfani
moderation.content: Tun da Caakus yana samar da sadarwa ta murya da bidiyo mara bayyana suna, muna amfani da matakan kula da abun ciki don tabbatar da tsaron masu amfani da bin ka'idojin al'umma.

advertising.title: Talla da Google AdSense
advertising.content: Caakus yana amfani da Google AdSense don nuna tallace-tallace. Google na iya amfani da kukis da fasahohin kamanceceniya don nuna tallace-tallace dangane da ziyararku na baya zuwa gidan yanar gizon mu ko sauran gidajen yanar gizo.
advertising.optOutPre: Kuna iya ƙin shiga cikin tallan da aka keɓance ta hanyar ziyartar

changes.title: 11. Canje-canje
changes.content: Za mu iya sabunta wannan manufar. Da fatan za a duba wannan shafin akai-akai don ci gaba da sane da canje-canje.

terms.title: Sharuɗɗan Sabis
terms.contactDesc: Don tambayoyi game da Sharuɗɗan Sabis ɗin mu, da fatan za a tuntuɓe mu.

1.title: 1. Yarda da Sharuɗɗa
1.content: Ta hanyar shiga ko amfani da Caakus, kun yarda da ɗaure da waɗannan Sharuɗɗan Sabis da dukkan dokokin da ka'idoji masu dacewa.

2.title: 2. Alhakin Asusu
2.content: Kuna da alhakin kiyaye sirrin bayanan asusu da dukkan ayyukan da suka faru a ƙarƙashin asusun ku.

3.title: 3. Halayen Mai Amfani
3.content: Kun yarda da rashin amfani da dandalin don cin mutuncin, cutar da, ko yaudarar wasu, ko buga abun cikin da ba bisa doka ba, mai cutarwa, ko mai ɓatarwa.

4.title: 4. Cancanta da Ƙayyadaddun Shekaru
4.content: Sabis ɗin mu an yi shi ne don masu amfani masu shekaru 18 zuwa sama. Ta hanyar shiga Caakus, kuna tabbatar da cewa kun cika wannan buƙatun shekaru. Idan kuna ƙasa da 18, da fatan a daina amfani nan take.

5.title: 5. Sabis ɗin da Ake Samarwa
5.content: Caakus yana samar da dandalin sadarwa na bidiyo, murya, da zamantakewa na ainihi tare da fasaloli kamar kiran bidiyo, tattaunawa ta murya, kyaututtuka na kamala, Tsabar YUYU, jadawalin masu jagoranci, da samun kuɗi na masu ƙirƙira. Muna da haƙƙin gyara ko dakatar da sabis a kowane lokaci ba tare da sanarwa ba.

6.title: 6. Ƙayyadaddun Nauyi
6.content: Caakus ba shi da alhakin duk wani asara kai tsaye, a kaikaice, na gefe, ko sakamakon da ya taso daga amfanin ku da dandalin.

7.title: 7. Canje-canjen Sharuɗɗa
7.content: Za mu iya sabunta waɗannan Sharuɗɗan Sabis lokaci zuwa lokaci. Ana ƙarfafa masu amfani su duba wannan shafin akai-akai don sabuntawa.
